remaining_gates: recover and hash-bind the exact verified 46 accepted ABI atoms and pinned tokenizer identity
prove the real training formatter serializes only intended model input/target fields and cannot leak metadata/family labels
materialize ABI symbols and re-run one-token and atom-row integrity tests
add split-isolated lexical families beyond the three semantic anchors without reopening nuisance shortcuts

research_return.hypothesis: The episodic binder should be learned from a factorial local-routing curriculum whose nuisance structure is provably nonpredictive, while architecture-policy families remain a separately measurable curriculum channel.
research_return.counterhypothesis: Even leak-free factorial prompt structure may overfit the three semantic anchors or interact destructively with architecture-policy specialization.
research_return.falsifier: On frozen lexical/template/symbol holdouts, require >=0.90 dynamic binding and cross-template transfer while retention gates remain within tolerance; compare curriculum schedules at matched tokens.
research_return.go_harness_implication: Expose nuisance-only decoders, display-order counterfactuals, mapping shuffles and binder lesion/rescue separately from multi-node HCU behavior.
